description: A low-poly, stylized bookshelf with a cabinet base. The bookshelf features two open shelves supported by dark brown vertical posts. The shelves are a bright yellow. The cabinet base has two dark brown doors with small, light brown, rounded handles. The overall design is geometric and minimalistic, giving it a modern and somewhat playful appearance. It is adorned with a few decorative items: a small potted plant on the top shelf and several books on both shelves, in various colors like blue, red, and green. The structure stands on four short, angled legs.
